test_plan.unit_of_inference: 16 paired world-seed clusters, never 352 independent sessions

frozen_primary.outcome: mean physical stability cost with early-stop penalty2 as already defined by R5; lower better
frozen_primary.strongest_control: best mean-cost among the 16 already-fixed conventional instances on the same 16 paired worlds; selection set frozen in advance, no learning/tuning from test; resample baseline selection per bootstrap draw
frozen_primary.seed_gate: at least two of three candidate seeds improve mean stability >=10pct relative to strongest comparator and paired world bootstrap lower MSE gain >0 and no mean survival degradation

bootstrap.resample_unit: world_index only; cluster all seeds and arms together

frozen_primary.early_stop_signal: source calibration must have separately passed R5 frozen non-saturation requirements before any sealed source; that source admission is not implemented here
frozen_primary.compute_report: all 352 trial sessions and 16 independent paired worlds, each actual chosen effect and up to two strictly hypothetical queries; total process CPU/GPU/memory/external effects later required
frozen_primary.capacity_parity: not inferred from number of world sessions; separately trained strongest conventional baselines and per-model compute matching needed

qualification.engineering: source-neutral fabricated-fixture replay only plus exact final G4 Windows/Ubuntu G5 Windows/Ubuntu G7 Ubuntu
qualification.future_native_receipts: not accepted or parsed by this module; owner runtime independently required

negatives: wrong world-seed or mismatched cross-policy unit
model selected counterpolicy with >2 hypothetical queries per chosen action
unknown or zero unqualified effect action
survival below strongest competent baseline fails
large mean gain with negative paired-bootstrap lower bound fails
unapproved external owner receipt cannot be treated as source
source first-use never dispatched, no workflow/runner/queue edits
